requirements.next_action: Confirm the custodian role and usable access privately; publish a sanitized dated attestation only.

requirements.required_evidence: Owner confirms an authorized custodian has an approved Windows signing route, including timestamping and renewal/revocation responsibility.
requirements.next_action: Confirm the signing route and custodian privately; do not create or purchase an account automatically.

requirements.required_evidence: Retain hashes and sanitized signing/notarization verification for representative app, bundled helpers and installer on both Mac architectures; record signing-route availability separately from worker confinement.
requirements.next_action: After access is confirmed, rehearse the actual packaging path without exposing account or certificate details.

requirements.required_evidence: A responsible operator confirms a reserved Windows 11 x64 environment, documented OS build, reset method and ability to run offline tests without developer tools; retain a sanitized benign/hostile probe result.
requirements.next_action: The owner has only the development Mac; no Windows 11 x64 environment is available. Establish permitted Windows 11 test access and a responsible operator, or record an explicit scope/date decision while keeping this gate unpassed.

later_checkpoint.purpose: Test the actual downloaded signed installer after reset, offline and without developer tools.

requirements.requirement: Clean Apple Silicon Mac test access
requirements.required_evidence: A responsible operator confirms a reserved Apple Silicon environment, documented OS version, reset method and ability to run offline tests without developer tools; retain a sanitized probe result.
requirements.next_action: The sole available machine is the existing Apple Silicon development Mac. Assess a reversible clean-test arrangement and responsible operator; current development access does not establish a clean environment.

later_checkpoint.purpose: Test the actual downloaded signed/notarized package after reset on every advertised OS boundary.

requirements.required_evidence: A responsible operator confirms a reserved Intel Mac environment, documented OS version, reset method and ability to run offline tests without developer tools; retain a sanitized probe result.
requirements.next_action: The owner has only the Apple Silicon development Mac; no Intel Mac environment is available. Establish Intel Mac test access and a responsible operator before claiming Intel support.

later_checkpoint.purpose: Test the actual downloaded signed/notarized package after reset on every advertised OS boundary.

requirements.required_evidence: An operator confirms the reserved 16 GB-class host and sanitized OS/architecture/CPU class/storage class/memory/thermal-power configuration, synthetic workload capacity and repeatable measurement/reset procedure.
requirements.next_action: Assess reservation and repeatable benchmark conditions on the sole available 16 GiB development Mac. Its availability for development does not establish an exclusive reservation or completed benchmark.

later_checkpoint.purpose: Run 100,000 transactions and 10,000 pages including 1,000 scans with concurrent map/graph use, measured p95 and peak memory.

requirements.required_evidence: Retain an explicit owner-approved version/build range for Windows 11 x64, macOS Apple Silicon and macOS Intel, with compatible runtimes/confinement, boundary test coverage and matching packaging metadata.
requirements.next_action: Decide minimum Mac versions and supported Windows 11 builds after platform probes; a framework default or current developer OS is not an acceptance decision.

later_checkpoint.purpose: Confirm every advertised OS boundary with installed-artifact evidence.

requirements.required_evidence: A qualified maintainer accepts the role and review dates, records the required independent review path and commits to evaluating the evidence for exact candidate hashes; preserve required PR reviews.
requirements.next_action: The owner is the only human contributor and no independent maintainer is available. Obtain a qualified independent review commitment; sole ownership does not authorize self-approval or bypass required PR review.

later_checkpoint.purpose: Review candidate completeness and record remaining conditions before final sign-off.

requirements.required_evidence: A qualified security reviewer accepts the role, review scope and dates covering threat model, native confinement, network policy, hostile inputs, licences/SBOM and recovery; retain sanitized acceptance or conditions.
requirements.next_action: No independent human security reviewer is available. Obtain a qualified reviewer and commitment before security acceptance; do not infer that the owner accepted this role or remove independence requirements.

later_checkpoint.purpose: Complete evidence review and candidate-specific security acceptance before final sign-off.
